tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Public Sector Insurance company should be registered with IRDA or enabled by a Central legislation to undertake Insurance related activities
The tenderer should have similar work experience in providing services catering to Group Health and Accidental Insurance as per the sub-clauses given
One contract of providing services to at least 500 families under Group Health Scheme in last three years
Two contracts of providing services to at least 375 families under Group HealthScheme in last three years.
Three contracts of providing services to at least 250 families under Group Health Scheme in last three years

The list of the organizations where the tenderer is providing services for the last three years giving details of organization name, telephone and fax number with contract validity, type of families insured and total number of families insured by them may be provided for record and reference.

Satisfactory track record of performance against previous companies. In case of those bidders whose past performance is not found satisfactory against previous contracts, their tender is liable to be rejected

Annual Health Insurance business of minimum Rs 6 lakhs (Rupees Six Lakhs) or more premium in the last three financial years (viz.,2022-23,2023-24 & 2025-26). Documentary proof in the form of Balance Sheet / Annual Accounts is required to be submitted

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
